title: Millions Hit the Road and Skies as Labor Day Weekend 2026 Travel Rush Begins
snippet: As the final holiday weekend of summer kicks off, millions of Americans are packing airports and highways for Labor Day 2026. Here is what you need to know to navigate the rush.

title: No Charges to Be Filed Against Woman in Fatal Parking Spot Shooting
snippet: Prosecutors have declined to file criminal charges against a woman who fatally shot a man during a heated argument over a parking space, citing self-defense laws.

title: Norway Seizes Russian Ship to Cover Ukrainian Energy Damages, Igniting Fury in Moscow
snippet: Norwegian authorities have impounded a Russian vessel to fulfill a court-ordered compensation judgment for a Ukrainian energy firm, drawing immediate outrage from the Kremlin.

title: Fact Check: Trump Falsely Claims U.S. Banks Are Banned from Operating in Canada
snippet: Despite recent claims by Donald Trump that U.S. banks are prohibited from doing business in Canada, major American financial institutions have maintained active operations north of the border for decades.

title: Iran Feels the Squeeze as Washington's Pressure Campaign Takes a Heavy Toll
snippet: U.S. economic sanctions and targeted trade restrictions are visibly straining Tehran's financial system and narrowing its strategic options.

title: Democrats Block GOP Push to Lock Supreme Court at Nine Justices
snippet: Senate Democrats have shut down a Republican-led attempt to pass a constitutional amendment capping the Supreme Court at nine seats, keeping long-term judicial reform debates alive.

title: Horrific Shooting in Mexico Claims Lives of Prominent Musician, Pregnant Wife, and Family
snippet: A brutal attack in Mexico has left a popular local musician, his pregnant wife, their young child, and a nanny dead, sparking fresh outrage over violent crime in the region.
